subject: Renewal ops after-action: tiered surge pilot & term adjustment
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@helixai.com>, Tom Weber <tom.weber@helixai.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal health & proposed pilot for HelixAI

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we approach your renewal window I wanted to share a short readout of the usage health we discussed and propose a small, time-boxed pilot to validate a tiered surge approach ahead of the new term. Quick summary below — full data attached (usage_report_q2.csv, latency_benchmarks.pdf):

- Current state: 6.8M tokens/month, 95th percentile latency at 210ms for standard model mix; spikes during nightly batch jobs have produced short-lived KV-cache misses that increased tail latency.
- Opportunity: A 90-day pilot where we reserve a small dedicated burst pool and enable stronger prefix caching for your 2 heaviest routes. Expected outcome: 20–30% token-cost reduction during peak windows and consistent 95th percentile latency <180ms.
- Commercial ask: Add a short-term commit for burst credits (prepaid) and shift renewal term from annual to 18-month to smooth unit economics. We can surface a limited credit/rollback if production metrics don't meet agreed SLAs.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min sync to confirm scope and SRE checklist (options: Tue 9/1 10a PT, Wed 9/2 2p PT).
2) Sign the pilot MOP and billing addendum (I can push a DocuSign).
3) Kick off a 2-week smoke test before production ramp.

Are you available for a quick call Tuesday?

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: usage_report_q2.csv (spreadsheet), latency_benchmarks.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Russo <elena.russo@helixai.com>

Date: 2027-08-31T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal health & proposed pilot for HelixAI

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. A couple of clarifying asks before we lock a call:

- Can you surface the ROI math you mentioned (how you get to 20–30% token cost reduction)? A one-page sketch is fine — procurement will need that.
- For the burst pool: what guarantees do we have on preemption/priority relative to other customers? We run near-real-time inference during our evening window and cannot tolerate sustained tail latency.
- If we move to an 18-month term, we need clear breakpoints (60/120 days) where we can pause/scale back without penalties if production results aren't met.

Tom (cc) — any SRE concerns you want us to add to the agenda?

Elena
VP Product, HelixAI
elena.russo@helixai.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Russo <elena.russo@helixai.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal health & proposed pilot for HelixAI

Elena —

Thanks — answering inline below and attaching a concise ROI sketch (usage_report_q2.csv includes the run-rate breakdown):

> "Can you surface the ROI math?"
- Short answer: yes. See tab "ProjectedPilotROI" in the CSV. Key assumptions: 10% reduction in token spend from prefix/KV caching alone; additional 12–18% via routing to a quantized model variant for lower-fidelity background tasks. Net blended reduction estimated 22% for peak windows. I included scenario rows for conservative/expected/optimistic cases.

> "Guarantees on preemption/priority?"
- For the 90-day pilot we propose a dedicated burst pool with soft isolation and a priority token that gives queued requests preemptive access for up to configured headroom. We will instrument a Circuit Breaker to auto-failover to your standard route (no surprise errors) if capacity is saturated. We cannot provide absolute physical isolation on the hosted tier, but Dedicated-grade reservation is available if you want hard isolation (we can price that separately).

> "Breakpoints for 18-month term"
- Agreed: we will add milestone checkpoints at 60 and 120 days with measurable SLAs tied to the pilot KPI deck. If KPIs are not met, you may elect to reduce the committed burst amount without early-termination penalties; we will include a remediation plan.

Tom — Monica and I will include SRE-runbook items on the call. Proposed meeting: Tue 9/1 10:00am PT — Mateo, can you send a calendar invite?

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Renewals Lead | Redwood Inference
pri.yom.das@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: usage_report_q2.csv (contains model mix and ROI sketch)

Subject: After-action & next steps (pilot scope, docs, signature)

Elena / Tom / team —

Thanks for a focused call this morning. Short recap and agreed next steps so we have everything on one thread: 

Agreements:
- Pilot scope: 90-day tiered surge pilot targeting 2 routes (inference + reranking). Initial dedicated burst pool sized at 200 concurrent tokens headroom.
- KPIs: 95th pctl latency target <= 180ms during peak windows; blended token-cost reduction target >= 18% (conservative).
- Term: move to an 18-month renewal with 60/120-day checkpoints that allow HelixAI to scale down committed burst amount if KPIs are not met (no early-termination penalty).
- Pricing: pilot billed as prepaid burst credits; any additional consumption beyond pilot credits billed at standard overage rate. Monica will send the pricing addendum.

Action items and owners:
- Mateo: send DocuSign envelope for the pilot MOP and pricing addendum (link below). Target for signature by 2027-09-07.
- Monica: provide the billing addendum and a short note on how credits will appear on invoices.
- Priyom: push the KPI dashboard and a lightweight runbook to the shared Drive folder.
- Tom: confirm SRE checklist items (observability hooks, alert thresholds) by EOD 9/6.

Docs / links:
- Pilot docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBfHelix-PilotDocs
- DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123
- HubSpot deal: HLX-2027-1221

Attachments included in thread: usage_report_q2.csv, latency_benchmarks.pdf. We will circulate the signed MOP once the DocuSign completes (I will upload signed_multiparty_mop.pdf).

If any of this is incorrect or missing, please reply-all and I will update. Otherwise we will proceed to send the envelope and Monica will kick the billing piece.

Appreciate the collaboration — excited to prove impact quickly.

—Mateo
